current.text: Milwaukee traded Giannis Antetokounmpo to Miami. That removes his 33% usage from the Bucks offense.
Taylor Jenkins is the new Bucks head coach. Doc Rivers, who benched Rollins last season, is gone.
The Bucks backcourt is crowded. Tyler Herro, Kevin Porter Jr., Gary Trent Jr., Braden Burries, Kasparas Jakucionis and others all compete for guard minutes.
Experts project him to open the season as a starter next to Tyler Herro, ahead of Kevin Porter Jr.
Most experts see his role as secure, at worst as the second-best guard on the Bucks. Some still say the many guards and Jenkins' unpredictable rotations could cut his minutes.
He is on a very cheap contract and is heading for unrestricted free agency.
The Bucks may not re-sign him and could trade him. Experts think he could bring back one or two first-round picks.
Justin expects him to score about 20 points per game. He could even lead the Bucks in scoring under Jenkins.
He has top 40 upside, but that depends on how the Bucks use him.
Experts say an ESPN rank near 105 is far too low because he finished 51st last season. They draft him between pick 50 and the mid 60s (round 5 in mocks).
He is probably the best Bucks player to target in drafts, though the team's uncertainty lowers confidence.
The Bucks are expected to be a bad team, with a win total of 26.5. They do not own their draft pick, so they have no reason to tank.
Yahoo lists him as questionable for rest.

durable.text: He is a strong shooter, a solid defender and a good passer. Steals are a standout part of his game.
He fits best as a combo guard but is good enough to be a primary point guard. His floor is a low-end NBA starter.

note: Yahoo values him at 17 USD (rank 60) but ESPN at 2 USD (rank 104), and his average auction cost on both sites is only about 2 to 3 USD. Experts draft him around picks 50 to 65, so a bid in the low to mid teens is fair and anything near market cost is a bargain. His best categories are steals, assists and threes (z +1.3, +1.0, +0.9) and no category is flagged weak, so he fits any build. Early in the season, check whether he keeps the starting job and his minutes ahead of Porter and Burries under Jenkins, and watch for trade news before the 2027-03-04 deadline.
